info.title: Freeism Points–Markets API
info.description: Points-owned canonical contract for the eleven APIs consumed by Markets. Better Auth discovery, authorization, token, introspection and revocation endpoints remain standard provider endpoints and are intentionally not duplicated as application operations.

x-freeism-oauth-contract.userPrincipal: active pairwise sub, client, audience/resource, scope, expiry and saved connection must match
x-freeism-oauth-contract.m2mPrincipal: active token without user sub and with only M2M scopes; client and owned resources must match

get.summary: Get an immutable public Point Package Revision
get.description: Returns the immutable revision. The strong ETag is the quoted contentHash. If-None-Match equality returns 304 without a body.

Cache-Control.description: Exact cache policy: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

ETag.description: Strong ETag containing the quoted sha256 content hash

Cache-Control.description: Exact cache policy: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

x-freeism-content-hash.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme over UTF-8

post.summary: Check Point Package auction eligibility atomically
post.description: Checks all items in one Points D1 transaction. One ineligible item produces zero receipts and a safe sorted error list.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque idempotency key. The same key and canonical payload replay the initial HTTP status and domain result.

409.description: At least one item is ineligible. No eligibility receipt is issued.

userOAuth.description: Opaque Authorization Code + PKCE access tokens for ordinary user operations. Refresh tokens may renew only this user scope set.

connectionUnlinkOAuth.description: One-time Authorization Code + PKCE token after Google fresh authentication for normal unlink only.

scopes.points.connection.unlink: Deactivate exactly one active Points connection

settlementAdminOAuth.description: Dedicated Authorization Code + PKCE step-up for a 60 second, target-bound, one-use settlement retry assertion. It is not a resource Bearer for the eleven operations.

m2mOAuth.description: Opaque Client Credentials access tokens for Markets Worker M2M operations only. No user subject, user scope, refresh token, redirect URI, connection read, balance read, reservation create, unlink, or admin step-up.

ReservationStatusItem.x-freeism-terminal-correlation: ACTIVE requires terminalAt and terminalReceiptId null; terminal states require terminalAt; EXPIRED may have terminalReceiptId null
